report.subject: RFQ Analysis - HVAC Equipment for Marina Boulevard Project
report.analysis_content: Summary: Pacific Climate Solutions Ltd. requires a quotation for HVAC equipment for their Marina Boulevard project (5000 sqm). Key items include an Industrial Chiller Unit (60-Ton, Model ICU-60T), Air Handling Unit with Heat Recovery (15000 CFM, Model AHU-15K-HR), and Variable Refrigerant Flow (VRF) Outdoor Units (24HP, Model VRF-24HP). Requirements: Energy efficiency ratings, Singapore-compliant refrigerants (R-410A or R-32), BACnet integration, quotation within 14 business days, and delivery by December 15, 2023. Clarification needed on specific energy-saving features, filtration details, and voltage requirements (380V or 415V).

company_requirement.company_description: Industrial Chiller Unit, 60-Ton Capacity (Model ICU-60T), R-410A refrigerant, digital scroll compressor, energy-saving mode required
Air Handling Unit with Heat Recovery, 15000 CFM (Model AHU-15K-HR), MERV 14 filtration, VFD included
Variable Refrigerant Flow (VRF) Outdoor Unit, 24HP (Model VRF-24HP), Inverter technology, BACnet protocol, simultaneous heating/cooling
